$comment: Model IDs, effort levels, token prices, plan limits and pricing. Code reads these through @sb/config; never hard-code them.

variety.$comment: Variety engine Steps 1–2 (docs/plans/variety-engine.md). families also gates the editor's 'Druga podoba' button (POST /api/sites/:id/look, HQ sb-druga-podoba): the same text and photos in the next look of the site's template family (palette, font pair, a hero that takes the same props), away from the neighbours, no model call, saved as a version; with skeleton on it brings another skeleton too. Off until a twin eval shows the look distance within a trade goes up and judge medians hold (pnpm eval --twins --no-edits). skeleton: Step 4, each site its own header, phone actions, footer and section styles, at most one centred section per page (design.skeleton, spec v15), one call button per screen, never the street address as the hero's eyebrow, section rhythm and primary hue held in code; off until the twin judge has seen it (contact sheet: pnpm variety:skeleton).

costCuts.$comment: Generation cost cuts (docs/plans/cost-cuts.md items 1 and 7). secondCritiqueOnlyOnFailures: with limits.critiqueIterations 2, the second critique round runs only when the checks after the first round's patches still report failures (3 of 4 recorded second rounds returned no patches, ≈ €0.022 and 40–60 s of checks each); otherwise the job ends after round 1 and logs why. contentRetryAsPatch: a content answer that still fails validation after the code repairs gets an RFC 6902 patch fixing only the listed issues (≈ 300 output tokens instead of 3–5k), applied in code; a patch that doesn't apply or leaves issues falls back to the whole-JSON retry, all within limits.contentRetries. Both off until the 3-fixture critique eval and a full-scope eval on the fixtures that retried (gostilna, kmetija, instalacije) confirm them.

spendReservation.$comment: Every paid call reserves its estimated cost under the daily cap before it is sent (atomically, so parallel calls can't both take the last room) and books its real cost after. Model calls: input from the request's text at charsPerToken (Slovene and JSON run below 3) plus tokensPerImage per image (the API's ~1.15-megapixel resize, about 1,600 tokens), output at the stage's maxTokens, all at uncached prices: an upper bound for the output, an estimate for the input. Generated pictures reserve their configured price.

checker.$comment: Public website checker (/pregled): a URL in, a report in plain Slovene out (mobile speed, tap targets, cookies before consent, the ZEPT company details). No model calls. Runs in the worker, one at a time (Chromium + Lighthouse, like a generation's checks). perIpPerDay per keyed IP hash (cleared after a day), perDay for everyone together; reports and URLs are deleted after keepDays. Only public http(s) addresses on ports 80/443; every redirect hop and every browser request to a private address is refused.

analytics.$comment: Stranko's own product analytics (docs/plans/analytics.md Steps 1 and 3, HQ sb-analytics = own-plus-cf). events: write product_events rows where a funnel step happens (landing view, intake, preview ready and opened, sign-in, claim, full site, publish, export, plan change, limit hit, upsell, domain) and one 'generation' row per generation job (stage seconds and EUR, checks, pictures, cap hits, direction). Rows carry a keyed hash of the device cookie, never an IP or an email; nothing reaches generation, specs or rendered sites. Off until the owner has read the /zasebnost sentence it adds (shown only while on); /admin/funnel and /admin/engine are always there and read empty without it. keepDays: raw rows are kept this long, then the worker's hourly housekeeping rolls them into daily counts (product_events_daily, kept). landingDedupeMinutes: one landing view per device in this window (like site visits). onceMinutes: an upsell shown or a preview opened counts once per device and site in this window.

cloudflare.$comment: Cloudflare Web Analytics (docs/plans/analytics.md Step 2; sb-analytics = own-plus-cf; the owner created the site and sent the token). Cookieless beacon, only on /, /login and /zasebnost and only when the request's hostname is one of hosts, so local runs, tests and the railway.app address get none; never on the dashboard, editor, admin, previews or published sites. The token is public (it is in the page). token null turns it off everywhere.

stats.$comment: Cookieless counts per published site (it-site-stats-report): page views (counted when a published page is served), taps on call and directions links (a beacon from stats.js, only from the live /s/ address, never the preview or an export) and contact-form messages. Only daily totals per site are stored. The visitor's IP is used in memory as a keyed hash to skip the same visitor reloading a page within visitDedupeMinutes and to cap tapsPerVisitorPerDay; it is never stored. The monthly report email goes to the site's owner account from the web process, from reportFromHour on day 1 (in timeZone) for the previous month, at most once per site and month (Resend idempotency key), retried every retryEveryMinutes up to maxAttempts within the first reportWithinDays days.

companyLookup.$comment: it-zept-lookup. The editor fills the legal name and address from a Slovenian tax number typed in 'Še to potrebujemo' or Podatki, asking the EU VIES REST service (free, no key; POST check-vat-number, fields valid, name, address). Only VAT-registered businesses are in VIES; the matična številka isn't, it stays a typed field. Nothing from VIES is stored or logged by the server: the values go into the fields and are saved like typed text. timeoutMs: after it the owner types the facts. Rate limit per viewer (account, admin) and for everyone together, in-memory, per windowMinutes.

seo.$comment: it-seo-basics. Published sites carry canonical URLs, hreflang, og tags, JSON-LD, robots.txt and sitemap.xml once they have an address (their primary domain, else <slug>.<PLATFORM_DOMAIN>). indexSiteHosts: when true, a site served on its own hostname is sent without the X-Robots-Tag noindex header. Everything on the app's origin (dashboard, /s/ and /preview/ paths) always keeps noindex. Off until the platform domain exists.

domains.$comment: Own domains (docs/plans/custom-domains.md, it-domain-flow). enabled shows the domain step after Objavi; off until real providers are wired (only the in-memory fakes can be selected: registrar and edge 'fake'; dns 'fake' answers as if the owner's CNAME were in place, 'system' asks real DNS). tlds are offered in this order; priceEurPerYear is what the owner is shown (VAT included; the yearly plans include the domain), maxCostEur the most we pay the registrar for a name (a premium or repriced name is not offered) and may not exceed plans.costs.domainEurPerYear. .si: registry fee EUR 10, expected EUR 10-13 at the reseller (research 2026-10-03); the .com cost is not confirmed yet. Provisioning runs in the worker (queue 'domain'): a failed step is retried after retry.baseSeconds * 2^n, at most retry.maxSeconds apart and retry.maxAttempts times; a step that waits (the registry, the owner's DNS record, the certificate) may wait waitHours before it counts as failed. suggestions: the registrar is asked about `check` names and `show` available ones are offered; the worker asks while the site generates and the answer is reused for cacheMinutes (it-zero-to-live). The worker looks for due steps every sweepSeconds; one run holds its domain for leaseSeconds. The 'live' email to the owner goes from the web process (it has the mail settings) every notify.everyMinutes, at most notify.maxAttempts tries.

formEmail.$comment: Contact-form email to the site's owner account (Resend; nothing when the site has no owner account). The message is stored first; the submit waits at most waitMs for the send, then answers the visitor the same either way. A failed or slow send stays pending and the web process retries it every retryEveryMinutes, at most maxAttempts sends in all, for messages received within retryWithinHours (under Resend's 24 h idempotency window); then it is marked failed and the owner's message list says the email didn't go out. Resend's idempotency key (form message id) keeps a retry from sending twice within 24 h. Visitor limits: limits.formMessages*.

composition.$comment: Report-only targets for the generated homepage's first screen (eval), phone 360×800 and desktop 1280×800. Photo share applies only when the client gave photos. They don't fail a checkpoint.

versions.$comment: Spec version retention (owner's decision sb-autosave-versions = prune, 2026-10-01). Every editor autosave stores a full version. A nightly job (cron, read in timeZone) keeps every version from today and the keepAllDays whole days before it, then only the last version of each older day, plus every version that was ever published and the current one. Versions never change; files only pruned versions used are removed with them.

backups.$comment: Nightly pg_dump of the database to the bucket (docs/dev/workflow.md §4, owner's decision sb-dev-workflow): pnpm db:backup writes backups/<UTC date>.sql.gz, deletes those older than keepDays, then checks the newest one; pnpm db:backup --check only checks. The schema alone dumps to about 8.5 KB compressed (measured 2026-10-07), so minBytes catches an empty or failed dump; minShareOfPrevious catches one cut short.

imageGen.$comment: Images from fal.ai: eval fixture photos (pnpm fixtures:ai-photos) and, for client sites with fewer than pipeline.fillUpTo photos, up to that many generated mood images, labelled on the site (owner's decisions 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01). A homepage preview uses 2 (hero + one image-text; keeps it under the €0.30 preview target), a full site 3. Needs FAL_KEY; without it the pipeline skips generation. Prices from fal's pricing API on 2026-09-30; gpt-image-2.5 is token-billed, so its per-megapixel price is fal's 1024x1024 high-quality estimate ($0.05268) scaled by area.

pipeline.$comment: fillUpTo is for paid plans and the admin; a paid plan also stops at its plans.*.site.generatedPicturesPerMonth (counted per allowance month, held at each picture's reservation). fillUpToFree: the most generated pictures in a free preview (no account or a free account; homepage only), fewer than a paid homepage to keep the free cost down (it-plan-limits).
pipeline.style: Realistic photograph, natural available light, true-to-life colours, an ordinary everyday setting in Slovenia. No people's faces, no text, no lettering on signs or packaging, no logos, no shop fronts, no watermark, no borders.

worker.$comment: Shutdown and recovery of the job worker. On SIGTERM it takes no new jobs and lets running ones finish for Railway's draining window (the service variable RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS, Railway's default 0 s) minus drainReserveSeconds, or drainSeconds when that variable isn't set (docker compose stop waits 10 s); jobs still running then are marked interrupted (site 'failed' with a retry, ai_jobs 'interrupted', not counted). A worker killed without that (SIGKILL, crash) stops its jobs' pg-boss heartbeat; after heartbeatSeconds pg-boss fails them and the next recovery pass (at start and every minute) marks them the same way.

accounts.$comment: Owner accounts (sb-signin: email magic link only, no passwords). Session and device cookies are httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure when deployed. Magic links are random, stored hashed, single-use; requests are rate-limited per normalised email and per keyed IP hash (the IP itself is never stored).

tiers.$comment: Free generation limits (docs/plans/free-generation-limits.md; owner's decisions sb-free-tiers = 1-2-10, sb-ai-allowance = first-month, sb-bot-check = Turnstile). Every model and image job is checked before it is queued, against its estimated cost; the real cost comes from the per-call log. anonymous: homepages per device, unclaimed previews deleted after keepDays. free (email account): homepages and chat edits in total, not per month; the anonymous preview carries over without using one. paid (and allow-listed before billing): a monthly € allowance of allowancePercentOfMonthlyPrice % of plans.paid.monthlyEur, plus firstMonthExtraEur in the first month; months run from the day the account got paid rights. perIpGenerationsPerDay: anonymous and free generations per keyed IP hash in 24 h (loose: mobile networks share IPs). pools: each tier's share of limits.dailyModelSpendCapEur per UTC day (admin jobs use the paid pool); a warning at warnAt of a pool. estimatesEur: what a job may cost, held until its calls are logged (measured: homepage with 2 generated pictures €0.26, full site with 3 ~€0.43, chat edit ~€0.012; photo descriptions are one vision call for all of a job's photos: 1 photo €0.002, 3 €0.006, 8 €0.015 in the evals, so altTextPerPhoto €0.005 leaves room for one paid retry). junk: shorter descriptions, or a classifier confidence below the minimum, are refused before any Sonnet or image call. minClassifierConfidence 0.12 from pnpm eval:junk --record on 2026-10-07 (Haiku 4.5, 22 cases): 8 of 10 junk scored 0.10 and are refused; a prompt injection and 'just curious' scored 0.15 and pass (one capped preview each); every real business scored 0.15 or more (tutoring, driving school and vet exactly 0.15), so none is refused. Not separable by this confidence alone: refusing a real owner costs more than one junk preview.

anonymous.$comment: Uploads without an account: the bot check and the limits run first (a signed one-time ticket, valid ticketMinutes), then at most maxTotalBytes of request body (declared size checked before reading, the stream cut off past it), maxPhotos photos, maxFileBytes per file.
anonymous.$comment2: reminder (it-upsells): a visitor may leave an email on their preview for one message daysBefore days before it is deleted (day 5 of 7), sent from the web process every everyMinutes, at most maxAttempts tries; the address is deleted with the preview.

free.$comment: sb-tiers (proposed 2026-10-03): a free account gets `homepages` more and `chatEdits` in total, and never costs more than lifetimeEur, its claimed anonymous preview included (counted from real costs).

altText.$comment: Photo descriptions (alt job, the vision model) for photos an owner adds in the editor: photos per account in 24 h, on top of the tier's pool (and a paid account's allowance). Adding and replacing photos is never limited; over the cap the owner writes the description. Anonymous visitors can't add photos; the admin has no count.

legal.$comment: it-landing-claims. The provider's own facts, shown in the landing footer, /zasebnost, /pogoji and /dostopnost. null until the legal entity exists (sb-legal-entity): every null is a marked placeholder on those pages, and the launch check (apps/web/src/legal.tsx launchProblems, logged at startup) lists it. companyName: full registered name; address: one line (street and number, postal code and town); registrationNumber: maticna stevilka, 7 or 10 digits; taxNumber: 8 digits, with SI in front once VAT-registered; email: where owners and visitors write to us. terms: the four points of /pogoji that are decided with the lawyer (cancellation and refunds, liability, how changes are announced, governing law and court), in Slovene as they should read; null is a marked placeholder. lawyerReviewed: set a page to true once a lawyer has read it; until then it says 'Osnutek' and the launch check lists it (checklist for the lawyer: docs/legal/lawyer-checklist.md).

plans.$comment: Phase 1 has no billing; kept here so later phases read from config.

freePreview.$comment: watermark (owner's decision sb-preview-watermark, 2026-10-02): "app-badge" = a small "Predogled · Stranko" badge in the app beside the preview frame (editor, guest preview, sites list) while the viewer has no paid plan and the site isn't published; never in the site's own HTML, so preview stays equal to published output. "off" = no badge.

plans.$comment2: Paid plans (sb-pricing 2026-10-01 for Osnovni; sb-tiers proposed 2026-10-03 adds Plus). Whole euros, VAT included, the same whether or not we're VAT-registered. billingEnabled stays false until the legal entity exists (sb-legal-entity); while it's false the landing page calls these planned prices. Every plan must make money even when its owner uses the whole AI allowance: the schema checks each price against `costs` (VAT taken off, the domain, hosting, card fees) and refuses a config where any plan, the founding year or the AI top-up could lose money.

costs.$comment: Worst-case costs per customer, for the margin check. domain: .si ~€10–13/yr at the reseller (registry fee €10, research 2026-10-03). hosting: a share of Railway, the edge and email per site. vatRate: Slovenia's 22 %, taken off even while we're below the VAT threshold. Card fee: Stripe's EU card rate.

upgrade.$comment: Moving up to a dearer plan (docs/plans/pricing-tiers.md: Plus at renewal with the unused months credited; up at once, the difference credited). credit "unused-whole-months": what was paid for the current period, pro rata for the whole months left, comes off the new plan's price for a new period starting now. Pure rule (upgradeQuote in @sb/config); nothing charges it until billing exists.

aiTopUp.$comment: 'AI paket': more allowance this month when the plan's is used up; earns money, at most maxPerMonth. Not sold yet (needs billing).
